stimuli.text: Read the passage and answer the questions: In contemporary professional environments, workplace stress has emerged as a pervasive and insidious phenomenon, often undermining both organizational efficiency and employee well-being. Far from being a mere by product of demanding schedules, chronic occupational stress is frequently rooted in deeper systemic issues such as unrealistic expectations, inadequate support structures, and a pervasive culture of constant connectivity. The relentless pursuit of productivity, amplified by technological advancements that blur the boundaries between personal and professional spheres, has exacerbated employees' sense of perpetual obligation. Left unchecked, prolonged exposure to high-stress environments can precipitate a range of deleterious outcomes, including burnout, diminished cognitive functioning, and even serious physical health conditions like hypertension and cardiovascular disease. Organizations that fail to recognize and address the underlying causes of stress not only risk elevated turnover rates but also compromise innovation, morale, and overall competitiveness. Counteracting workplace stress demands a multi-faceted approach that transcends superficial interventions such as temporary wellness programs or occasional mindfulness workshops. Instead, it requires a fundamental re-evaluation of work design, leadership styles, and organizational priorities. Encouraging open dialogue about mental health, instituting flexible work arrangements, and fostering a culture that genuinely values work-life balance are pivotal steps toward cultivating a more sustainable and humane professional landscape.

explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:10:source:645e2cb3b47e0: Each letter is shifted forward by one: N→O, E→F and so forth. Apply the same shift to CAPTURE.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:11:source:59767612de3b5: On a die, faces appearing together at one corner are adjacent. Compare the views, rule out adjacent faces and identify which pairs of views establish each opposite face.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:12:source:bfaa4de96ade3: Trace which edges of the given drawing meet after folding. An admissible answer must preserve all line intersections and cannot introduce a new crossing.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:13:source:e039e138f8b0f: Check punctuation as well as words: the comma immediately after “14” and the hyphen before the PIN code are decisive.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:14:source:bb53edd9d6dc9: The statement says what happened for staff who attended, but does not establish that Ms Chen attended. Nor does it say what non-attendees experienced. Neither conclusion follows.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:15:source:fbab5c04e4a54: Each source letter moves one alphabet place forward (G→H, A→B, M→N, E→F). Hence P→Q, L→M, A→B and Y→Z.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:16:source:0c4b42ac4d115: Observe successive multiplication by three with small subtractions: 14×3−1=41, 41×3−2=121, 121×3−3=360. Continue the adjustment pattern.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:17:source:c604422637242: Read each row as: first number + (second number)² − third number = last number. Row 1: 54+7²−4=99; row 2: 62+8²−7=119; row 3: 55+11²−6=170. The diagram shows 54 (not 64) in the first cell.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:18:source:26609ac6f1cee: The numbers are cubes of Fibonacci numbers: 1³,1³,2³,3³,5³,8³,13³. Thus the G term uses 13³.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:19:source:ebd6322fc5141: N=O<P≤Q directly gives N<Q; also M≥N=O gives M≥O. Both are guaranteed.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:20:source:5eba5b6770c8e: Draw eight equal positions around a circle, remembering everyone faces outward, so their left is clockwise. Place H, then B,D,C and complete all constraints before reading E's right neighbour.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:21:source:40d4083795ada: On 1 January 2019, a person born 14 November 1983 is 35 years old, within the inclusive 30–35 band. M.Tech 76%, written 73%, interview 73% all qualify.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:22:source:3a7eee6aa16e4: Across the figure series, track the separate symbol columns and their vertical movement; check that the fourth frame's successor maintains every repeating cycle.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:23:source:22537feeebc84: For the first three pairs the second number is the first divided by three. The fourth pair does not satisfy that relation (1496÷3 is not 492).
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:24:source:df2d91743b8cd: Every letter moves forward one alphabet position: INDIA→JOEJB. Apply to DELHI.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:25:source:ce7800932cfdc: Not scored. National security is an important consideration, but allocating public funds to development during peace is also a relevant argument. The premises do not establish an objective single best answer.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:27:source:e327b3a5dcc0a: The statement explicitly liberalised foreign investment. It dealt primarily with chronically sick public enterprises and referral to BIFR; a workable private-sector exit policy was still debated in 1993 (Goswami Committee).
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:28:source:7a999da0f537f: All four acquisitions were covered by the DAC AoN on 3 July 2026 (PIB).

explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:34:source:68b29c8cef096: 2026 senior women’s final: Ariha Pangambam won with 19.100; silver was Kanokpit Mali (Thailand), and bronze Mahiro Kishibe (Japan). Thus statements 1 and 2 are true, statement 3 false.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:39:source:28871d24acf7e: The question treats Vaisakhi as Sikh New Year; more precisely Vaisakhi commemorates the formation of the Khalsa and the Punjabi harvest, while the Nanakshahi calendar new year falls in March.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:42:source:8446cfbe99c7e: The 2026 International Booker Prize went to author Yáng Shuāng-zǐ and translator Lin King for Taiwan Travelogue.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:44:source:a8f93c803e17c: The Third Plan ran 1961–1966 and suffered from wars and drought. The rupee was devalued in June 1966, after the Plan had already ended in March, so it was a response to the crisis, not a cause of the Plan’s failure.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:45:source:fa690a4b0e9d0: The event was held in Jakarta on 3–16 July 2026; India finished third with 29 medals, including five gold. In this question, three women and two men won gold.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:47:source:564c094e3b928: DRDO handed over the Final Operational Clearance of Netra AEW&C to the IAF on 25 June 2026.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:48:source:b06764d086ef3: Aravindh Chithambaram was the first Indian chess grandmaster to qualify for the 2026 Esports World Cup chess main event.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:51:source:025525c522fee: Treat 13 cm as apex-to-base-vertex slant edge: h = √(13² − (5√2)²) = √119 ≈ 10.91 cm.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:52:source:bf8e1ea057da3: Congruence order is significant: △KLM≅△XYZ implies K corresponds to X. Corresponding angles are equal.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:53:source:9dd0108b8cd11: Add the two quantities before checking other properties: √5+(5−√5)=5, which is rational.

explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:55:source:0cd60827ae996: Equal profits imply equal capital×time. Set 18000×12=36000×(12−m), and solve for Manju's joining delay m.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:56:source:48ccf0689688f: Set u,d as upstream/downstream speeds in km/h. Solve 20/u+44/d=8 and 15/u+22/d=5; then still-water speed=(u+d)/2 and convert km/h to m/s.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:57:source:073e35b6c871b: Let original costs be a and m: a+m=36 and 3.5a+8m=162. Solve, then evaluate 7a+2m.

explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:60:source:0245cc88e9de1: Let a pen cost p and a notebook n. Equations: 4p+5n=130 and 2(1.25p)+4(0.8n)=82. Find p+2n.
explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:62:source:77edc090c5c7e: If A:B:C:D=4:7:9:12 and C−B=₹12000, two ratio parts equal ₹12000. E is the mean of A and D, i.e. eight parts. Sum all 40 parts.

explanations.cgl-2026-09-30:q:97:source:7b11d85dfb060: For formal passive interrogatives, “By whom were the plaques ... vandalised?” is the strongest choice, but informal “Who were ... vandalised by?” is grammatical.
